title: Swampy Server Mod
description: The Swampy mod is used for the Swampy server, but can also be used on any other.
body:
Swampy Server Mod replaces Minecraft’s main menu with a custom swamp‑themed background and updates the Singleplayer and Multiplayer screens with a cleaner layout. It also adds several new music discs, with the required server‑side files included for multiplayer support. Menu backgrounds can be customized by replacing the textures inside the mod’s JAR.

Features
Swamp‑themed main menu background

Updated Singleplayer and Multiplayer menus

New music discs with server support

Customizable menu textures

Lightweight and modpack‑friendly
